steps.title: Three files, loaded as modules
steps.titleZh: 三个文件，都以模块方式加载
steps.text: The console shows `animal` from prototype.js, then `1` and `true` from combination.js. Each file is a module, so both can declare `Parent` and `Child` without clashing, and the page cannot reach their functions. The next steps rebuild the key moves here.
steps.textZh: 控制台先显示 prototype.js 的 `animal`，再显示 combination.js 的 `1` 和 `true`。每个文件都是模块，所以两个文件都能声明 `Parent` 和 `Child` 而不冲突，页面也拿不到它们的函数。接下来几步在这里重演关键操作。

steps.title: A shared prototype leaks
steps.text: `Child.prototype = Parent.prototype` makes the two constructors share one object. Setting `constructor` for `Child` then changes it for `Parent` too.
steps.textZh: `Child.prototype = Parent.prototype` 让两个构造函数共用一个对象。给 `Child` 设置 `constructor` 时，`Parent` 的也跟着变了。

action.run: function Parent() {} function Child() {} Child.prototype = Parent.prototype; Child.prototype.constructor = Child; console.log('new Parent().constructor === Child:', new Parent().constructor === Child)

steps.title: Object.create links without sharing
steps.text: `Object.create(Parent.prototype)` makes a new object that falls back to the parent's prototype, without running `Parent` and without sharing its prototype.
steps.textZh: `Object.create(Parent.prototype)` 创建一个回退到父类原型的新对象，既不运行 `Parent`，也不共享它的原型。

action.run: function Parent() {} function Child() {} Child.prototype = Object.create(Parent.prototype, { constructor: { value: Child } }); console.log('shared:', Child.prototype === Parent.prototype, '| linked:', new Child() instanceof Parent, '| Parent intact:', new Parent().constructor === Parent)

steps.expectConsole: shared: false | linked: true | Parent intact: true
